equipment_type: Water-source DOAS controller with energy recovery
applies_to: WaterFurnace Versatec 700 indoor dedicated outdoor air systems: up to four variable speed water-source heat pump modules with an energy recovery wheel, economizers and DCV, on the Aurora UPC.
summary: BACnet point list for the WaterFurnace Versatec 700 indoor DOAS. System points cover enable, emergency shutdown, occupancy, SAT targets and reset, blower and duct static control, sensor sources and BAS overrides, dehumidification and reheat, DCV and water- and air-side economizers. Each of up to four heat pump modules has its own block (unit 1 below 100, units 2-4 in the 1000s, 2000s and 3000s), and the energy recovery unit sits in the 9000s.
notes: Object names are the sheet's reference names; it also prints display names.
Heat pump blocks for units 1-4 are all printed and listed; points for absent units do not apply.
The 'Factory or Internal Use Only' group (about 140 rows) is marked do not map; listed for completeness as internal-use points.
AV 3 carries the same numbered mode list as MV 11. Fault codes in AV 6/7 (per unit) and AV 9009 (ERW) decode with the alarm tables on the workbook's second and third sheets.
MV 308 is printed with state 2 twice (Unit 1 Sensor and Unit 2 Sensor); the second is probably 3.
The sheet does not state the BACnet transport or network settings.

integration.summary: Enable the system with BV 302, pick the external schedule on BV 401 and drive occupancy with BV 400 (or MV 315 for standby and temporary occupancy). Set the cooling and heating SAT targets and reset options, and read mode, supply air temperature and the per-unit fault codes.

minimum_points.name: sys_enable_c
minimum_points.why: System enable for network and setpoint control

minimum_points.name: sched_select_c
minimum_points.why: Must be External for BV 400 to apply

integration.enable: BV 302 sys_enable_c enables the system for network and setpoint control. BV 2 e_stop_c is the emergency shutdown, BV 102 a shutdown that keeps the exhaust fan running, and BV 4 load shed. Occupancy follows the internal schedule unless BV 401 is set to External; then BV 400 or MV 315 set the occupancy mode.
integration.remote_sensors: Each sensed value has a source selector and a BAS override: MV 303-307 and MV 311 pick Rnet sensor, unit/ERW sensor or BAS for supply, return, space and outdoor values, written on AV 502/505/512/515/522/525/532/535. MV 309/310/312/314 pick BAS or AEC for the energy recovery inputs (AV 9024-9065). AV 551 takes a BAS DOAS control temperature, AV 343 a BAS duct static value, and AV 591/593 BAS CO2 and VOC.
setup: MV 301 sets the blower configuration (multizone VAV, single zone VAV, CAV) and MV 302 the SAT control type; set them at commissioning.
gotchas: Points for heat pump units that are not installed stay meaningless.
Return BV 8 alarm reset to Off after use.
